scope: 30 paired representative short four-wheel replays, not every changed road; two additional motorway80kmh cases and the East ramp incident replay are separately included. Longitudinal speed prescribed in the paired sampler; steering and vertical dynamics integrated, solid barriers excluded.

reviewedWarnings.reason: Retain the measured increase at the corrected grade transition: peak <1.5m/s², four wheels continuously supported, no rejection, contact chatter, impulse or safety action. Raw regression flag is retained; this is not a claim that every metric improved.

eastInterchangeRegression.note: Initial 80km/h ramp traversal; speed at incident is measured, not prescribed. Real support/vertical dynamics and ordinary longitudinal coasting. Not a whole-map driving test.
